executed.testAdequacyForSecurity: The fix-cycle tests cover one hold source without a reference state (the Situation 1 entry sign), a stated cause after a declaration, the rejection of client restart fields, a foreign and a tampered row, and identical replays. No test covers: a restart with no stated pause (it throws), a new stop after training resumed post-declaration, a review whose event id is already on record with a different payload carrying a sign, a non-string or reused event id, an intake naming another athlete id, a restart dated before a hold, or a CLINICAL_HOLD row that is altered or deleted.

verdict.scope: the offline core boundary of 5ee9dec only (no server, client, logging or analytics exists in this repository)
verdict.summary: The cycle closes most of what it set out to close: client intake can no longer carry restart facts, a stated cause is screened, every one of nine hold sources now writes a CLINICAL_HOLD fact and the record alone blocks a new plan, foreign, tampered and future rows are never read, restrictions must be answered, unknown keys are never echoed, replays add no row and no V1CP string claims a clearance. The boundary still fails on the restart path and on clinical-first: (1) an old readiness declaration still stands in for the cause of a new stop after training resumed, so the A1 reason is never asked (SEC-V1CPI-02 residual, RC-11); (2) a warning sign answered yes in a review whose event id is already on record now gets an id question instead of the clinical route, a regression from fa3985b (SEC-V1CPR-03, RC-01; the task contract's 'relevant sign being ignored' trigger, in a narrow form). Defence-in-depth gaps in the new hold mechanism (SEC-V1CPR-01, -02), a crash of the default no-stated-pause restart (SEC-V1CPR-04) and the erasure tombstone (SEC-V1CPI-06, named blocker) remain.
verdict.boundedCycleNote: This was the single narrow recheck. Under the bounded-cycle rule the blockers above are closed as named blockers with owners, not reopened here; the Chief routes them (a new mission or a Founder-authorized cycle).
verdict.escalation: TASK_CONTRACT ESCALATE_IF 'a relevant sign being ignored' fires narrowly (SEC-V1CPR-03: a chest-pain yes under a reused event id is answered with an id question). Routed to the Chief. No G07, G08, G09, G10, PCG or Founder decision is needed for the interim fail-closed fixes; the RC-11 matching rule for recognising the historic episode stays with SSCTR and PCG as already recorded in SEC_V1CP_IMPL.

newFindings.title: On the restart path, an F08 row readableF08 rejects is read as absent, and the owner and clock come from the intake
newFindings.scenario: Hold on record (swelling yes), then a readiness with AVOID_LOWER_BODY_STRENGTH. (a) The CLINICAL_HOLD row's declaredAt altered by 1 ms: restart PROPOSED (r3 RH-c). (b) The intake names athlete id 'ath-v1cp-hybrid-2' with the same record: the hold is not read (PROPOSED) and the restriction is lost, 32 lower-body rows instead of 0; fa3985b kept the restriction with the same input (r3 RH-d, r3e). (c) A restart whose intake asOf is two or more days before the hold: PROPOSED (r3 RH-e).
newFindings.impact: A hold or a restriction in force fails open on inputs a client controls in the core contract (the record, intake.athlete.id, intake.asOf). Equivalent to deleting the row; a regression for restrictions.
newFindings.required: In restartIntake, a record row that fails the predicate, names another athlete or is dated after the restart's clock gives HOLD or ASK (counting rows, naming no content), never an empty read; restartProgram takes the athlete id from a bound source (a required parameter, or every F08 row must match the intake's id); directed tests for (a) to (c).
violates: SEC_V1CP_IMPL SEC-V1CPI-04 required ('a failing row gives HOLD, never silently honoured or dropped')
PCG RC-11 (restrictions in force carry over)
newFindings.mitigation: Unreachable once RECORD-CUSTODY holds and the server binds the athlete id and the restart's clock.

newFindings.title: A clinical decision can leave no CLINICAL_HOLD fact, and a new plan then unlocks
newFindings.scenario: (a) Event id 4242 (a number) with an illness flag: CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED, no hold fact, restart PROPOSED (r2 S-numeric). (b) A CLINICAL_HOLD row of another athlete planted with the next event id: the real hold is not written, restart PROPOSED (r2 S-planted). (c) An event id reused after a released hold: the new hold is not written, restart PROPOSED (r2 S-reused). (d) A stale clinical reference sent after a release with a chest-pain report: the review is answered from the stale state, the sign is never read or recorded, restart PROPOSED (r2 S-stale). (e) A malformed actualLedger with a clinical flag: no ledger and no fact returned (r2 S-malformed).
newFindings.impact: The record alone again fails to show a standing hold, which SEC-V1CPI-03 was fixed to guarantee.
newFindings.required: The review contract refuses a non-string or empty event id (HOLD); withHoldFact deduplicates only on a readable row of this athlete with the same id and no later READINESS_DECLARED; a reference whose asOf predates the latest readable F08 fact is refused, or counts as standing only when the record holds an unreleased hold; directed tests for (a) to (d).
newFindings.mitigation: (b), (d), (e) need a client that controls the record or the reference (RECORD-CUSTODY removes them); (a) and (c) need only an integrator's id scheme.
